meta.name: Prestigious Law Firm
meta.description: A refined, authoritative design direction for a top-tier law firm — blending institutional gravitas with modern digital sophistication. Inspired by Paul Weiss and Davis Polk.

primary.role: Brand anchor — deep navy used for headers, primary navigation, hero backgrounds, and institutional identity

secondary.role: Supporting slate blue — used for secondary text, metadata, captions, and de-emphasized UI elements

accent.role: Corporate blue — used for overlines, card accents, interactive highlights, and CTAs. Cool-toned, consistent with Paul Weiss palette.

neutral.usage: Nine-step scale from pure white to near-black. Backgrounds alternate between first three values. Text uses bottom three.

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast dark-on-light dominant. Navy text on white/cream backgrounds. Reversed in hero sections with white text on navy.

typography.font_style_notes: Serif headings convey institutional authority and tradition. Sans-serif body ensures readability and modernity. Display weight is light (300) to feel elegant, not heavy. Overline text uses wide tracking and uppercase for labeling practice areas and categories.

spacing.section_rhythm: Alternating generous vertical spacing — 96px between major sections on desktop (clamp-scaled down to 48px on mobile). Inner content uses 32–48px vertical gaps. Breathing room is a design feature, not wasted space.

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px — used on cards, inputs, and table cells. Color is neutral-300 (#E4E7EC). Never decorative.
shape.divider_style: Thin 1px horizontal rules in neutral-200. Used between content sections and list items. No ornamental dividers.

elevation.depth_cues: Shadows use the primary navy tint rather than pure black — creates warmer, more refined depth. Elevation is used sparingly: dropdowns, modals, and sticky nav only.

iconography.preferred_set: Lucide or Phosphor — clean, professional line icons. No filled icons. No emoji.

motion.philosophy: minimal functional — motion exists to orient and confirm, never to entertain. Restraint is the hallmark of prestige.

components.button_style: Primary: navy background, white text, no border-radius, subtle letter-spacing. Hover: lighten 10%. Ghost: transparent with 1px navy border. All buttons are rectangular — no rounded pills.
components.input_style: Rectangular with 1px neutral border. Focused state adds navy border. No inner shadows. Label above, not floating.
components.card_style: White background with 1px border on neutral-200. No shadow at rest, low shadow on hover. Content padded 24–32px. Optional gold accent top-border for featured items.
components.navigation_pattern: Horizontal persistent nav with logo left, links right. Sticky on scroll with subtle shadow. Dropdown menus appear on hover with 200ms delay. Mobile: full-screen overlay menu.
components.modal_style: Centered with backdrop blur, high elevation shadow. Max-width 640px. Close button top-right.
components.list_style: Clean typographic lists with generous line spacing. Horizontal rules between items. Metadata (date, practice area) in caption text.
components.component_notes: Components are deliberately understated. The design communicates prestige through restraint, not visual complexity. Every element earns its place.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A senior partner's corner office — mahogany undertones translated to digital. Everything curated, nothing casual.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary minimalism anchored by neoclassical sensibility. Think 2020s digital craft meets 1920s institutional architecture.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous and intentional — whitespace is the primary luxury signal. Content never feels crowded. Sections breathe.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Top-heavy — hero and firm identity commands attention, then progressively lighter as user scrolls into content.
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element — one powerful statement or image per viewport, supported by sparse secondary content
visual_language.contrast_level: High contrast between primary content and background. Low contrast between secondary elements for visual hierarchy.
visual_language.texture_usage: None — surfaces are flat and clean. The only textural quality comes from serif typography and professional photography.

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy — scale, weight, and color create all structural differentiation. No boxes or badges needed.
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom editorial scroll. Left-to-right reading within sections. No lateral or unconventional flow.
composition.grouping_strategy: Whitespace and thin dividers group related content. No colored section backgrounds until late in the page.
composition.negative_space_role: Load-bearing — negative space does as much work as content. It signals confidence and selectivity.

imagery.photo_treatment: Professional color photography with natural lighting. Attorney portraits are formal but approachable — not stiff. Cityscapes show global presence. All images use subtle desaturation (-10–15%) for cohesion.
imagery.illustration_style: Not used — illustration would undermine the institutional tone.
imagery.graphic_elements: Minimal. Thin horizontal rules, occasional gold accent lines. No decorative graphics, patterns, or abstract shapes.
imagery.pattern_usage: None — patterns would add visual noise contrary to the restraint principle.
imagery.image_shape: Rectangular with no border-radius. Full-bleed hero images. Inline images maintain 16:9 or 3:2 aspect ratios.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Understated — color shifts and subtle opacity changes confirm interactions. No bouncing, scaling, or playful feedback.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Text links gain underline on hover. Cards lift with low shadow. Buttons darken 10%. Navigation links shift to gold accent.
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth glide — 300ms ease-out for all state transitions. Nothing snappy, nothing bouncy.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Skeleton screens matching content layout. No spinners — spinners feel impatient. Graceful placeholder-to-content reveal.
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low — interactions are confident and singular. No cascading animations on every scroll event.

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Authoritative and measured. Copy is precise, never casual. No exclamation marks. No emoji.
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: High — the UI speaks like a managing partner addressing a client. Professional but not cold.
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle suggestion — 'Learn More', 'View Profile', 'Explore Our Practice'. Never 'Click Here!' or 'Get Started Now!'
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Brief, helpful direction: 'No results found. Adjust your search criteria.' No illustrations or humor.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Formal and solution-oriented: 'We were unable to process your request. Please try again or contact us directly.'

overview.fallback_strategy: disable effects — site must function perfectly without any JS-driven effects

background_effects.description: No animated or generative backgrounds. Prestige is communicated through content and typography, not visual spectacle.

particle_systems.description: No particle effects — would undermine institutional credibility.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements. The design relies on 2D composition and typography.

shader_effects.description: No shader effects. Visual identity is achieved through restraint.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Elements animate when 20% visible in viewport
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: None — animations trigger once and complete. No scroll-scrubbing.

text_effects.description: No text splitting, typewriter, or animated text effects. Headlines appear via standard fade-up with the rest of their section.

cursor_effects.description: Standard system cursor throughout. Custom cursors feel gimmicky in this context.

image_effects.description: No hover distortion or WebGL image effects. Images are presented cleanly. Hover on attorney cards may add subtle shadow lift.

params.filter_pipeline: Slight desaturation (filter: saturate(0.85)) for visual cohesion across diverse photo sources

svg_animations.description: No SVG path animations or morphing. SVGs used only for static icons and logos.

visual_effects.composite_notes: This design deliberately avoids visual effects as a strategic choice. In the white-shoe law firm genre, restraint IS the effect. The absence of animation, particles, shaders, and 3D communicates that the firm's reputation speaks for itself. The only motion is functional: gentle fade-up on scroll entry and smooth hover state transitions. Performance is excellent by default because there is nothing to render.
